data.standardized_narrative: The statement of financial position shows gross claims outstanding (claims reserves) at 31 December 2015 of GBP 117.86m (this is the opening reserve for 2016). The report pages contain technical provisions tables and claims development material, but a clear, explicitly labelled gross "movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding" figure was not unambiguously extractable from the available scanned pages, so no single gross prioryear movement amount is reported here.
data.data_quality_notes: Document supplied as scanned images with rotated pages. I was able to read the Balance Sheet / Technical Provisions table showing "Claims outstanding" closing 31 Dec 2015 = GBP 117,860k (hence opening_reserves_gbp_m = 117.86). However I could not unambiguously locate a labelled GROSS prioryear movement ("Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding" in the Insurance liabilities column) in the scanned pages - there are technical provisions and claims development tables present but the scanned quality and layout prevented reliable extraction/calculation of a definitive gross prior-year development number. Therefore prior_year_development_gbp_m is null. Gross premiums written (total) taken from the Income Statement gross written premiums line = GBP 198,979k. If you can provide a higher-resolution PDF or point to the exact page/note number for the "movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding" (insurance liabilities / gross column) I can extract the gross prior year development and populate the related fields.
